text: I feel a mixture of curiosity and anticipation as I enter this space. The modern design, glass walls, and bold display about R+D (Research and Development) suggest innovation and progress. It prompts me to reflect on humanity's constant quest for understanding and improvement, and how every environment can be a laboratory for new ideas. There is a sense of openness—both literally, in the architecture, and metaphorically, in the invitation to think and experiment.
